short: Assemble a determinant from its factors

lean.name: Formalism.ThetaLiftIndependence.DetChain
lean.plain: Assemble a determinant from its factors
lean.note: Suppose several operators act by scalars on matching direct-sum blocks of equal dimension. If another operator acts on each block by $\kappa$ times the product of their scalars, its determinant is $\kappa$ raised to the total dimension, times the product of their determinants. This formulation is outside the final dependency cone.
